loze / is Subsequent Period To

is Subsequent Period To

Property

The relation that obtains between a period of time p and another period of time p' if and only if p immediately follows the end of p' along the temporal axis

https://loze-ontology.org/isSubsequentPeriodTo

For example

The XIX century is subsequent to the XVIII century, the 4th of May of 1999 is subsequent to the 3rd of May of 1999, the year 1768 is subsequent to the year 1767

Specialisation

Asserting a sub-property asserts its own domain and range, not just the parent's. Anything you put either side is taken to be of the narrower class, whether or not you said so.

isLaterThanPeriodPeriod Of Time → Period Of Time
isSubsequentPeriodToPeriod Of Time → Period Of Time
Note

Since the 4th of May of 1999 starts when the 3rd of May ends, one could argue that there is actually an instant of time that belong to both the 3rd and the 4th; these are complex issues at the interface of metaphysics and mathematics that we cannot address here; however, their practical relevance is nil, since we will never need to refer to instants, but only to extended, non-instantaneous periods of time

loze is a top-level ontology after E. J. Lowe's four-category ontology, with Zemach's schematic particulars. Every term here is identified by an IRI under https://loze-ontology.org/.
